violation_type.title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads (26 TAC §747.2315(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Equipment for Infants - Bean Bags, Waterbeds, Foam Pads
violation_type.typical_finding: An infant was observed on a bean bag during the inspection.    This was corrected at inspection when the infant was picked up.

finding_variants.text: An infant was observed on a bean bag during the inspection.    This was corrected at inspection when the infant was picked up.
During the inspection an infant was observed sleeping on their back on a foam couch cushion. This was corrected when the child was moved to a pack and play.
Two children were observed sleeping on a boppy pillow in a play yard.
